import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, palette='Set2')
plt.xlabel('BMI Category')
plt.ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
plt.title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
